signal: Vanilla Forums, now Higher Logic Vanilla, runs a unified customer-community platform spanning forums, Q&A, knowledge base, and ideation for thousands of B2B and B2C brands.

email.body1:
Lauren, Higher Logic Vanilla running one unified community platform across forums, Q&A, and knowledge base puts a lot of buying signals in front of the team at once.

The trouble is usually signal-to-action latency: more in-market accounts firing than ops can route to reps before they cool. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Vanilla off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lauren, quick follow-up for Vanilla.

Most sales-ops teams know the data is messy and the follow-up is late, but can't quantify what that costs in booked meetings. The fix is rarely more reps, it is closing the gap between a signal firing and a personalized touch going out.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Lauren, last bit of proof for Vanilla.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Vanilla's reply rate likely compares to peer community-software teams. Want to grab a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lauren, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action latency isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Ops work pulls you a dozen directions, and timing matters more than the pitch.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Vanilla either way.
